sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 760. Success value 100. 2x physical damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Activates Vital Strike (10% chance to increase Damage by 50%) for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies frenzy (nullifies debuffs, nullifies status ailments, permits piercing through damage reduction and damage reflection) for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies the following effect for 120 seconds: Fills Unison gauge by 2 when using an Ability.
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 120 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Phalanx for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; nullifies debuffs; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies special debuffs. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects). Recover 100 Cost and fill your Unison gauge by 30 when this effect is removed).
-Applies Wind Qualia (increases all stats by 100%, increases wind elemental attack by 10, increases wind elemental defense by 150, and nullifies Slumber and Stun) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 35000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 120 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
Water and Wind Defense from Unison Damage +600
